title: Fernhall Securities: follower stopped mirroring after a leverage change

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Morning, it's Isla at Fernhall Securities. One of our follower accounts has stopped copying, and I can't see why.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: It's FR-720418. The client dropped their leverage from 30:1 to 10:1 yesterday, and nothing's mirrored since.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Right, with lower leverage, every trade we copy needs more margin. If there isn't enough free margin, we skip the trade rather than open a smaller one.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: But they've got plenty in the account. Shouldn't it just scale down?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: It depends on the copy mode. In proportional mode it scales down, in fixed lot mode it doesn't.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: So is this account on fixed lot or proportional?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: I can't see that from here, I'd have to check the account settings.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: And the trades it missed, will they still open?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Er, no, I'm afraid not. Once the margin check passes, it'll only copy new trades from the leader.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Okay, can you check the settings and get back to me this afternoon?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Yep, I'll email you by three.
